title: Integer arithmetic: product and sum facts

problem_text: Find two positive integers with product 12 and sum 7.
student_prompt: Answer this short repair question. Keep your working brief.

error_category_mapping.diagnostic_sentence: If the pair 3 and 4 does not appear from product 12 and sum 7, the next link is checking factor pairs against two conditions. This habit supports monic factorising later.

hint_ladder.title: Product and sum
hint_ladder.prompt: What do 'product' and 'sum' each ask for here? You need one pair of numbers that satisfies both conditions at the same time.

hint_ladder.title: List factor pairs
hint_ladder.prompt: Start with the factor pairs of 12. After each pair, check whether the two numbers add to 7.

hint_ladder.title: Two conditions
hint_ladder.prompt: A common slip is finding numbers that multiply correctly but forgetting to test the sum. Keep both checks beside each pair.

hint_ladder.title: Pair-check routine
hint_ladder.prompt: For product-and-sum work, list pairs for the product first, then test the sum. Apply that routine here; do not copy the previous problem.

common_errors: uses the previous larger problem instead of this repair skill
expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: This repair focuses on matching one factor pair to both the product and the sum, so practise writing the pair checks before choosing an answer.
